description: The sections a lead's fields are grouped into (the `acq` in `acq:utm_campaign`). ONE row states everything a section is: which CRM Lead Table field holds its rows, whose columns they are, whether a lead may carry many of them, and which column addresses one. Every reader — the partner API, the Facebook fold, intake, Smart Views, the Data tab — asks this table; the answer is never restated on a CRM Lead API Field row.

fields.label: Section Key
fields.description: The prefix in a field key: the `acq` in `acq:utm_campaign`. Every catalog field naming this section is routed by the row below.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: The heading these fields are shown under, on the Data tab and in a partner's error messages.

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: Ascending: a lower number sits higher on the page. Sections are rendered in this order.

fields.label: Target DocType
fields.description: The doctype whose columns these fields are. Every field naming this section is resolved against it, so a field that is not one of its columns is refused.

fields.label: Child Table Field
fields.description: The Table field on CRM Lead holding these rows, e.g. custom_lab_profile. Left blank the section IS the lead row itself, and the target must then be CRM Lead.

fields.label: Is Multi Row
fields.description: A lead may carry many of these rows — a lab report per date, a drug cycle per date. Ticked, a write upserts the row named by the Row Key Field and leaves every other row untouched; unticked, the one row is merged onto and a second incoming row is refused.

fields.label: Row Key Field
fields.description: The column identifying one row, e.g. report_date. Required when multi-row: it is the address a write is applied at, is always accepted even where a partner's grid has not ticked it, and is marked required in that section's schema. On a key-value section it is the column carrying the concept a row answers.

fields.label: Is Key Value
fields.description: One row per concept, where a catalog field's Fieldname addresses a ROW rather than naming a column. Ticked, the Row Key Field carries the concept and the Value Field carries the answer, so a new concept is a catalog row and never a schema change. Mutually exclusive with Multi Row.

fields.label: Value Field
fields.description: The column holding a key-value row's answer, e.g. value. Required when key-value; every consumer reads the answer through it.

fields.label: Label Field
fields.description: The column holding what a key-value row is CALLED, e.g. label. Required when key-value: the identity is a digest, so this is the only thing a person can read.

fields.label: Question Field
fields.description: The column holding the raw key a key-value row's identity was derived from, e.g. question. Kept so a row can say what it was hashed from.

name: CRM Lead Section
